activeDecisions.content: NOMAD Direct ROS2-MAVLink architecture COMPLETE. Files deployed to Jetson Docker (/workspaces/isaac_ros-dev/): 1) vio_bridge.py - ZED odom to MAVROS vision_pose at 30Hz, 2) nav2_mavros_params.yaml - Nav2 config using ZED point cloud for costmap and ZED odom for localization, 3) nomad_task2.launch.py - Launch file with critical remap /cmd_vel to /mavros/setpoint_velocity/cmd_vel_unstamped. No Python middleware needed! Nav2 commands go directly to ArduPilot.

DIRECT ROS2-MAVLINK ARCHITECTURE VERIFIED WORKING on Jetson Orin Nano (mad@100.75.218.89). Full stack: ZED2i camera -> vio_bridge.py -> MAVROS -> Cube Orange ArduPilot. VIO flowing at 30Hz from /zed/zed_node/odom through /mavros/vision_pose/pose to ArduPilot EKF. No Python middleware needed! Nav2 should publish directly to /mavros/setpoint_velocity/cmd_vel_unstamped for velocity control.

FINAL STATUS Jan 29: VIO bridge deployed to Jetson at /workspaces/isaac_ros-dev/vio_bridge.py in Docker nomad_isaac_ros_32. SSH: mad@100.75.218.89. ZED running at 30Hz. MAVROS connected to Cube Orange (MANUAL mode). To run full stack: 1) docker exec bash, 2) source ROS, 3) python3 vio_bridge.py. NEXT: Run VIO bridge, configure Nav2 params to publish /mavros/setpoint_velocity/cmd_vel_unstamped, verify ArduPilot receives vision pose on EKF.

NOMAD COMPLETE ARCHITECTURE STATUS: Jetson SSH: mad@100.75.218.89, Docker: nomad_isaac_ros_32. Components verified working: (1) ZED wrapper at 30Hz VIO on /zed/zed_node/odom, YOLOv26 on /zed/zed_node/obj_det/objects, (2) MAVROS connected to Cube Orange at /dev/ttyACM0:921600 in MANUAL mode, (3) VIO bridge created at /workspaces/isaac_ros-dev/vio_bridge.py. NEXT STEPS: Run vio_bridge.py, configure Nav2 to publish /mavros/setpoint_velocity/cmd_vel_unstamped, test full system. Edge Core nav_controller.py can be deprecated - direct ROS-MAVLink is working!

NOMAD ROS2 architecture verified working on Jetson: ZED wrapper publishing VIO at /zed/zed_node/odom (30Hz), object detection at /zed/zed_node/obj_det/objects. MAVROS connected to Cube Orange via /dev/ttyACM0:921600 inside Docker container nomad_isaac_ros_32. Need remapping: /zed/zed_node/odom -> /mavros/vision_pose/pose for EKF, /cmd_vel -> /mavros/setpoint_velocity/cmd_vel_unstamped for Nav2

Edge Core refactored to mission orchestrator only - NOT navigation controller. Responsibilities: HTTP API, WASD velocity publisher (→/cmd_vel), high-level Nav2 action client, health monitoring. Removed: velocity translation, safety limits, command timeouts (Nav2 handles)

Nav2 integration approved: Eliminate nav_controller.py middleware, use mavros2 for direct ROS2-to-MAVLink communication. Architecture: Nav2 → /cmd_vel → mavros2 → SET_POSITION_TARGET_LOCAL_NED → ArduPilot GUIDED mode
NOMAD Video Bridge (nomad_video_bridge.py) uses GStreamer NVENC for zero-copy hardware H.264 encoding with 150ms glass-to-glass latency
Edge Core refactored from global variables to FastAPI app.state dependency injection for thread-safe service management

Isaac ROS bridge (isaac_ros_bridge.py) needs fixes for ZED+YOLOv26 integration. Current code expects Isaac ROS YOLO Detection2DArray but system uses ZED wrapper's ObjectsStamped messages. VIO topic, detection topic, and message parsing all incorrect.
Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) pipeline handles indoor navigation for Task 2
Edge Core API runs on port 8000 with uvicorn ASGI server on Jetson Orin Nano

EKF Source Control Panel implemented in Mission Planner plugin: EkfSourceControlPanel.cs provides UI for switching ArduPilot EKF sources (GPS/Vision/OptFlow), with auto-switch based on GPS fix and force-vision toggle for outdoor VIO testing. DualLinkSender.cs has SetEkfSource() method using MAV_CMD_SET_EKF_SOURCE_SET (42007).
Dynamic multi-stream video system supports runtime topic switching without pipeline restart via HTTP API
ZED camera model changed from zed2 to zed2i for hardware compatibility (nvblox only supports zed2/zedx)

NOMAD uses hybrid ROS setup: ZED ROS wrapper provides camera, depth, VIO, and YOLOv26 object detection. Isaac ROS provides only nvblox for 3D mapping (subscribes to ZED's depth+odom). This avoids Isaac ROS YOLO version limitations while getting nvblox benefits
NavController velocity commands use async queue processing with 3ms average latency and 5 m/s safety limits
Mission Planner plugin written in C# targets Windows Ground Control Station
Tailscale VPN used for remote connectivity between Jetson (100.75.218.89) and Ground Station (100.76.127.17)
H.265 video encoding deployed for competition to reduce bandwidth on RTSP streams with 200-300ms latency
Health dashboard displays Jetson GPU, CPU, memory, and thermal metrics in real-time
